about.title: Hi! I'm Maria Fernanda Melo e Reis.
about.text1: I'm 18, I live in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, and I study Software Engineering at PUC Minas. I'm currently an IT intern at ITShare, working on automation and AI-assisted development.
about.text2: I focus on building software that solves real problems, combining web development, automation and artificial intelligence.
about.goals: I'm interested in automation, applied AI and interface development. I want to grow as a software developer, learning by doing and shipping projects that people actually use.
